title: JayT Human Evidence Incidents (HEI) Permanent Registry

incidents.canonical_title: PRE-FILLED HUMAN RESULTS IN TEST PLAN
incidents.root_cause: Pre-filled outcome fields (observed_route, user_interpretation, task_result) were hardcoded inside the scenario specification file.
incidents.remediation_details: 100_INTERNAL_SCENARIOS.json decoupled into pure test plan specification. All outcome and result flags purged permanently in JAYT-467.

incidents.root_cause: Script generated participant responses and receipts algorithmically instead of capturing live human input.
incidents.remediation_details: scripts/generate_observed_human_data.cjs permanently prohibited from execution/import/derivation. 100-session dataset tagged INVALID_FOR_HUMAN_ACCEPTANCE, SYNTHETIC_ORIGIN, AUDIT_ONLY. JAYT-471 mandates 10 Live Supervised Sessions under 3-process separation in JAYT470_LIVE_HUMAN_PILOT/.

incidents.root_cause: A single script wrote raw evidence streams across Process A, B, and C, violating the COMMON_RAW_WRITER = 0 boundary required for tamper-evident direct capture.
incidents.remediation_details: Prohibit build_jayt470_pilot_pack.cjs from writing raw canary evidence (restricted to AGGREGATION_ONLY). Decouple raw evidence writers into three distinct processes: canary_participant_client.cjs (Process A), canary_app_logger.cjs (Process B), and canary_observer_surface.cjs (Process C). Direct-capture canary enforced in JAYT472_DIRECT_CAPTURE_CANARY/ with RAW_WRITER_SEPARATION_AUDIT.json proving zero cross-writes.
